title: Orbit Relay — Design Document
description: The same synthetic design document authored with portable Rich semantics for standalone, full-view, and embedded review.

blocks.title: Orbit Relay — Design Document
blocks.subtitle: Turn approved fictional field notes into a stable relay plan that stays legible in chat and a dedicated reader.

blocks.content: A small research team records observations in different places. Reviewers need one readable plan that keeps assumptions, choices, and constraints visible without turning the document into a dashboard.

### Goals

- Preserve a traceable source note for each relay decision.
- Make approval state obvious in a single reading flow.
- Keep the format useful in a narrow embedded surface and a wide standalone view.

### Non-goals

Orbit Relay does not schedule people, allocate budgets, or connect to external systems.

A relay record contains a source, a route, an owner, and a review state. Each record remains readable without interactive controls. A reviewer can scan the proposal, compare concise facts, and inspect the implementation boundary.

blocks.title: Implementation sketch

blocks.content:
A long title can consume too much horizontal space. Narrow layouts must retain readable text, accessible navigation, and no horizontal page overflow.

1. Is the source note sufficient for a reviewer?
2. Does the record separate approval from execution?
3. Can the document remain useful at 390 pixels?
